Name: Ebu's Maru Edit
Author: ebuaskew
Description:
I went into this wanting to give her braids, but in my struggle not to overdetail, they ended up looking more like locs. I'm still happy with the result either way, and I hope you find this a vast improvement over the original! Side note, I accidentally placed a pixel on her face that looked like a beauty mark, so I went with it 😂

These edits apply to the beach, winter, and hospital portraits, although I might redesign her hospital portraits later on and give her an updo to match the the sprites.

Downloads.Description: Maru's portrait with braided hair and a few small tweaks
